title: Overlap Levels
description: Bài học: bước sau bắt đầu trước khi bước trước xong bao nhiêu thì đổi cảm giác: 0 % ngăn nắp, 25 % gọn gàng, 50 % trôi chảy.

moworks.notes: Three rows of 4 squares pop scale 0 → 1, 350 ms power2.out each; in each row the next starts at the previous start + 350 ms × (1 − overlap), for 0 / 25 / 50 % overlap. Rule: 0 % tidy, 25 % crisp (standard), 50 % flowing; kit rule: the next starts when the previous is 30–50 % done. Params: each (0.35 s) · overlap (0 / 25 / 50 %). Kit rule: the next starts when the previous is 30–50 % done.
